# Weeber

> AI voice agents for businesses that miss calls.

## What is Weeber?

Weeber is a vertical voice AI platform that gives Shopify stores and insurance agencies/brokers an AI agent on a real phone number. For Shopify: recovers abandoned carts, confirms COD orders, and handles inbound calls. For insurance: follows up leads within minutes, reminds policyholders before renewal, and live-transfers to licensed advisors — never quoting, advising, or underwriting.

## Who is it for?

- Shopify and e-commerce stores losing revenue to abandoned carts and missed calls
- Insurance agencies and brokers whose warm leads go cold waiting on a callback
- Clinics, healthcare practices, and local service businesses (roadmap vertical, not yet built out)

## Key capabilities

- Cart recovery calls: automated outbound calls to recover abandoned Shopify carts
- COD confirmation: voice verification of cash-on-delivery orders to reduce RTO
- Feedback collection: post-delivery satisfaction calls with 1-5 ratings
- Appointment booking: inbound and outbound scheduling for service businesses
- Bilingual support: English and Hindi with natural conversational AI
- Compliance-first: TCPA, DNC, and GDPR enforcement built into the infrastructure

## Compliance

Weeber enforces consent and calling-window rules at the infrastructure level, with dedicated pages
per jurisdiction:
- India: https://www.weeber.ai/compliance/india — DPDP Act 2023, TRAI TCCCPR calling windows (9am-9pm IST), DND, DLT registration
- US/EU/global: https://www.weeber.ai/compliance/global — federal TCPA (8am-9pm), state mini-TCPA (FL/OK/WA cap at 8pm), GDPR data-subject rights
- Overview: https://www.weeber.ai/compliance

Mechanisms enforced today:
- Automatic Do-Not-Call list checks, no exceptions or overrides
- Calling-window enforcement by the recipient's jurisdiction, checked automatically per call
- Purpose-scoped consent (consent for one purpose doesn't authorize another)
- Full audit trail for every call (transcripts, recordings, disclosure version spoken)

## Integrations

- Shopify — live, self-serve one-click OAuth
- HubSpot, Salesforce, GoHighLevel — CRM sync, built and working, assisted setup (not self-serve)
- WhatsApp, WordPress, Google Calendar, Meta — roadmap
